verdict.rationale: Zero's founder describes it as an AI email client that drafts replies, and the MCP docs list composing emails with AI assistance, so AI-drafted replies exist as a product capability. Nothing in the evidence shows the drafts are tuned to the user's own voice and tone rather than generic text. missing for 10: evidence of voice/tone personalization (learning from sent mail or style settings), documentation of the review-before-send draft workflow in the client, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
